description: ScanGym lets you find and book gym day passes at thousands of gyms - no membership required. Search gyms by city or your location, compare day-pass prices, opening hours and reviews, then book a session as a guest with just your email. You pay securely on scangym.com and receive a QR code for gym entry. Free cancellation up to 2 hours before your session, with automatic refunds. Perfect for travellers, commuters, and anyone who wants to train without being tied to one gym.
